newsitem.title: USA: Lunar shares dive again on heavy volume.
newsitem.headline: Lunar shares dive again on heavy volume.

text.p: Shares in Lunar Corp plunged for the second straight day on Tuesday on heavy volume dominated by institutional block trading.
Shares in the maker of devices that measure the density of human bone were off 4 to 16 near the closing bell.
"The stock's been cut in half in two days now," said Adams Harkness analyst John Putnam.

On Monday, the Madison, Wis.-based company reported fiscal third quarter net income of $3.3 million on $19.9 million in sales, compared to year-ago net income of $2.6 million on sales of $17.3 million.
Lunar said that third-quarter sales were not up to its expectations due to lower than anticipated sales in Japan.
